content.short: Decubate TMS is a Token Management System offering vesting and staking infrastructure for token projects.
content.description: Decubate TMS is a Token Management System designed to streamline token-related work for founders and crypto projects. It provides vesting and staking infrastructure, along with a comprehensive suite of token-management capabilities, all accessed through a modern, intuitive interface. The platform is fully customizable and deployable within hours, helping teams cut costs and development time while delivering scalable, ready-to-use infrastructure for managing token programs and related activities.
